text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Trainer. Our teamwork is 
simply wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As a token of our support, we've specially 
prepared this for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Tazuna's special refreshments brought the 
team closer together, firing up everyone's 
motivation for the Aoharu Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, I also went ahead and 
upgraded the clubroom♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad if you liked it. Please keep 
doing your best from here on out.
